summary: Red Eclipse 2 is a first-person arena shooter styled after classic fast-paced competitive multiplayer games. It provides an environment for hosting deathmatch and objective-based multiplayer matches. The project is written in C and C++ and distributed primarily through Debian packages.
goodFor: It suits administrators wishing to host a traditional, self-contained arena shooter for LAN parties or small gaming communities.
watchOut: The project has a very low maintenance health score and has not seen a tagged release since late 2019, suggesting potential abandonment or lack of active support.
deployNotes: Hosting a game server typically requires opening specific network ports for client connections and managing persistent configuration files on your server.
